open_questions: cost_rank=12 is the design choice (behind gemini 10, ahead of codex 20/claude 30) to make kimi preferred for the NEW research task types without capturing the generic [research,strategy] funnel from the cheaper gemini lane. If OWNER wants kimi preferred for ALL research including research_strategy, cost_rank must go below 10 AND gemini's research capture must be re-examined — that is a routing-policy decision, not settled here.

Whether a routable DB `sources` row (extending farmctl.VALID_SOURCE_TYPES with 'internal_research') is wanted, or card+decisions-only per the existing AI-source precedent (AI-CODEX-... sources). cards_r1_research §2b defers this; it changes whether add-source accepts internal research.

Whether Kimi may ever be a SOLE critic. Directive §8 requires a non-Kimi critic for Kimi-authored work but is silent on whether Kimi can be the only critic for a Claude/Codex creator; agy is explicitly backup-only, so a parallel 'kimi backup-only until it proves itself' stance may be warranted for its first weeks (critic §2).
